evidence.note: The log-path writer sets logPending only as exitCode!==0 && !truncated && !runCompleted; the shape-class writer at 803 omits logPending so it stays the false default. Combined-true is never constructed.
Details contract: logPending is the in-progress materialization lag; once the parent run has concluded an unreadable log stops being pending. logPending therefore implies !runCompleted.

notes: Seed D1 correction. Legal: FT completed, FF in-progress with a fetchable or truncated log, TF in-progress log-pending. Schema defaults are FT; TT is not a supported producer state. Planner checks logPending first, so it is not E2.
